summary: Computes the distance between two collision feature offsets, then classifies the contact state stored in the low bits of the state word at this+20 (1 = potential contact, 2 = separated, 4 = contact). Bit 0x10 of the state word selects a plane-based contact path; otherwise a simple inner/outer radius test decides. The plane path evaluates per-plane distance equations against a threshold and rewrites the state accordingly. Always returns 0.

operations.description: Compute relative distance components v8/v7/v5 by adding a2[9..11] to the a3 vector components.
Compute the distance magnitude v15 = sqrt(v8*v8 + v7*v7 + v5*v5).
Branch on bit 0x10 of the state word at this+20 to select the plane-based contact mode path.
Simple path: if inner radius at this+244 < v15 < outer radius at this+248, classify as contact.
Set the state word to (v6 & 0xFFFFFFF8) | 4, encoding the contact state in the low bits.
Fall through of the simple path sets the state word to (v6 & 0xFFFFFFF8) | 2, encoding separated.
Contact mode: if plane count at this+252 > 4 and v15 - threshold at this+24 > a2[2], or (when a4 is zero) the radius test scaled by a2[34] fails, jump to the separated path.
Otherwise set the state word to (v6 & 0xFFFFFFF8) | 1, encoding potential contact, and remember it as v10.
If the plane count at this+252 <= 0, return 0 without evaluating any plane.
Iterate over collision planes starting at a2[65], stepping 4 floats per plane (a plane holds two normal components, a remaining normal component, and a distance term).
Compute v13 = -(planeNormalX * a3[0]) - (planeNormalY * a3[1]) - (planeNormalZ * a3[2]) - planeDistance.
If v13 > threshold at this+24, set the state word to (v10 & 0xFFFFFFFC) | 2 and return 0.
If v13 > -threshold at this+24, break out of the plane loop to the contact result; otherwise continue iterating.
After the plane loop, set the state word to (v10 & 0xFFFFFFFA) | 4 (contact bit set) and return 0.
